## Description

Scheduled jobs apply each country's record-retention rule (audio, transcripts, notes, documents, billing, audit) with legal-hold support; clinic-level handling of patient requests: access (export of the patient's record), correction (with audit, clinical content via addendum), erasure (where lawful; medical records under retention hold explained), withdrawal of recording consent (audio purge with receipt).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Retention jobs delete only data past its period and not under legal hold; deletions logged without PHI.
- [ ] **AC2.** Access requests produce a patient export within the legal deadline, tracked with due dates.
- [ ] **AC3.** Erasure requests explain partial fulfilment when retention law applies (status "Partially fulfilled · legal hold").
- [ ] **AC4.** Recording-consent withdrawal purges audio and records the purge receipt.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
